Class WorldScene

com.mygame.scene.WorldScene
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.jme3.anim.util.HasLocalTransform, com.jme3.asset.CloneableSmartAsset, com.jme3.collision.Collidable, com.jme3.export.Savable, com.jme3.util.clone.JmeCloneable, Cloneable
public class WorldScene extends com.jme3.scene.Node
Root scene node that initializes, updates, and tears down the world rendering systems while sharing a single source of sun state.
